summary: Iteration 29 - Liquidacion Export Feature Testing Complete. All 21 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests passed. The new 'Exportar Liquidación' button is visible and functional in Admin IA > Reporte de rutas tab.

design_issues.screen: Admin IA > Reporte de rutas table
issues: Dates in FECHA column show full timestamps (e.g., '2026-03-31 14:34:19.172000') instead of clean YYYY-MM-DD format. This is a display issue in the table, not the Excel export which correctly truncates dates.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider truncating dates in the routes report table to YYYY-MM-DD format for cleaner display
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/export-liquidacion endpoint returns 200 with valid .xlsx file - VERIFIED
Excel file contains all required sheets: Formato, {provider names}, Incidencias a cobro, Catalogo_Drivers, route_summary - VERIFIED
Formato sheet has 14 columns with correct headers and example row with formulas (=H2+I2, =K2/G2) - VERIFIED
Provider sheet has 28 columns (A-AB) with correct group headers in row 1 and column headers in row 2 - VERIFIED
Provider sheet formulas are real Excel formulas (=G3-N3, =IFERROR, etc.) not calculated values - VERIFIED
Provider sheet has freeze panes at B3 - VERIFIED
Provider sheet side table (col AD-AL) has pivot data per driver - VERIFIED
Incidencias a cobro sheet has correct headers (#, RUTA, Operador, Guías, MONTO) - VERIFIED
Catalogo_Drivers sheet lists unique drivers with provider mapping - VERIFIED
route_summary sheet has totals in rows 1-2, headers in row 4, and XLOOKUP formula in Driver Courier column - VERIFIED
Dates in Excel are clean YYYY-MM-DD format - VERIFIED
Frontend: 'Exportar Liquidación' button visible in Admin IA > Reporte de rutas tab - VERIFIED
Frontend: Button sends correct params (date_from, date_to, provider_id, etc.) - VERIFIED
Existing 'Exportar Excel' button still works unchanged - VERIFIED
Endpoint requires admin role (coordinator, developer, executive) - returns 403 for agent/proveedor - VERIFIED
context_for_next_testing_agent: Liquidacion export feature is fully functional. The endpoint /api/admin/export-liquidacion generates a multi-sheet Excel file with Belgos/SOP format. All sheets verified: Formato (template), Provider sheets (with real Excel formulas), Incidencias a cobro, Catalogo_Drivers, route_summary (with XLOOKUP). Role-based access correctly restricts to admin roles only.
